title: Moroccan Lamb Kebabs with Chinese Twist
description: A fusion of Moroccan and Chinese flavors, these lamb kebabs are juicy, tender, and full of exotic spices. Serve with steamed vegetables and a side of stir-fried noodles.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the kebabs with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with sesame seeds.
Serve hot with steamed vegetables and a side of stir-fried noodles.
